auth_details: Token via token header (not Authorization). Self-serve request at ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/token; emailed after approval.
free_tier_limits: Free with token; 5 requests/second and 10,000 requests/day (published service limits)
description: NOAA Climate Data Online (CDO) provides web services for accessing historical weather and climate data from the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). Developers can query stations, datasets, data types, locations, and daily/monthly/annual observations worldwide via a token-authenticated REST API returning JSON.
